topic: Number of Vietnamese feed mills in the ASC programme
claim_a: VASEP report of 22 Sep 2026: 20 mills in the programme, 13 certified (EXP-32)
claim_b: ASC Find a Feed Mill register queried 25 Sep 2026: 23 records, 15 certified, 6 in initial audit, 1 not awarded, 1 incomplete (FBA-04)
position_taken: Use the register, with its date; the difference is probably timing (Viet Uc and Proconco certified in July and August 2026, Nam Viet in August) or counting method

claim_a: Vietnam-reported 2023: USD 9.65 million, 1,934 t (net weight flagged as estimated by Comtrade) (FBA-18)
position_taken: Use partner-reported tonnage; Vietnam-reported weights are imputed with one unit value for all partners; report both values
notes: Values also differ in 2019 and 2020 (USD 5.98 and 5.91 million against 8.28 and 10.43 million); do not average

topic: Price of fishmeal to Vietnamese mills
claim_a: World Bank Peru 65% protein, CIF: USD 1,706 per t (2025), 2,500 per t (August 2026) (FM-01)
claim_b: Partner-reported FOB exports to Vietnam, all grades: USD 1,163 per t (2025), 1,622 per t (January to July 2026, partial) (FBA-20)
position_taken: Keep the World Bank series as the international benchmark and add the mirror series as what Vietnam pays; do not average
notes: Different grade, basis (CIF against FOB) and coverage

claim_a: Package: Sheng Long (Haid) is the largest shrimp feed maker (650,000 t a year complex) (FAC-054; IND-46)
claim_b: Grobest 2024 report: "retained market leadership in Vietnam" (FBA-13)
position_taken: Neither verified; keep the package view on capacity and record Grobest's claim as a company statement
notes: The segment behind Grobest's claim is not stated

topic: Whether Cargill still makes aquafeed in Vietnam
claim_a: Package: Cargill exited aquafeed in May 2025, closing its Dong Thap and Long An aquafeed plants (FAC-058; IND-47, Low)
claim_b: Cargill Vietnam website (25 Sep 2026) lists aquatic feed among its solutions (FBA-16)
position_taken: Keep the exit as Low confidence; the website may be generic; ask Cargill
notes: Cargill is not in the ASC feed register

topic: Which ASC Feed Standard text ch27 relies on
claim_a: ch27.5 cites the v1.1 text (EXP-29, May 2025)
claim_b: ASC states v1.1 never took effect and v1.2 (19 Dec 2025) has been mandatory since 2 Feb 2026 (EXP-30; FBA-01)
position_taken: Cite v1.2; the cut-off date and GHG rules are unchanged, and v1.2 adds the eligible-volume rule for soy and palm and a medium-risk exception to 2 Feb 2029
notes: Correction of citation, not of substance
